column1: # Rented servers by name (10 Oct 2026). One row per live server; delete the row when the user deletes the server.
# The machine-id (/etc/machine-id) is pinned: Hetzner hands a deleted server's IP — and often its name — to the next server, so a script that
# reaches the right IP may be talking to the wrong machine (157.180.32.149 was hel1-23 on 30 Sep and is the CCX53 now). tools/hosts.sh refuses
# a machine whose id differs. Columns are TAB-separated: name, ip, machine-id, what it is.
